title: signal.xz_verify request

expected_state.description: Action-specific expected_state input. Its type and accepted values are defined by this schema.

match_mode.description: Action-specific match_mode input. Its type and accepted values are defined by this schema.

signal.description: Final leaf signal path. Aggregate, array, and struct roots are not expanded automatically.

begin.description: Action-specific begin input. Its type and accepted values are defined by this schema.

end.description: Action-specific end input. Its type and accepted values are defined by this schema.

time_range.description: Closed analysis interval. begin and end may be omitted independently to use the available waveform bounds.

time_unit.description: Interprets only unitless time numbers; it never overrides a time string that already has a unit.

value_format.description: Action-specific value_format input. Its type and accepted values are defined by this schema.

description: Verify that every raw waveform value in a closed time window matches an X or Z state.
x-description-zh: 检查信号在闭合时间窗口内是否始终满足指定的 X 或 Z 状态。
x-purpose: 检查信号在窗口内是否始终满足指定 X/Z 状态。
x-how_it_works: 扫描 raw waveform 闭区间；exact 要求整向量全为目标态，contains 要求每个值至少含一位目标态。
x-when_to_use: 证明信号持续全 X、全 Z，或持续包含指定未知态。
x-arg_contract_notes: required: signal, expected_state, time_range; optional: match_mode(default exact)

use_when: 需要证明 raw waveform 在整个闭区间内始终为指定 X/Z 状态。
do_not_use_when: 只需要寻找一次 X/Z，或需要 clock-edge 表达式验证。

alternatives.when: 只需要发现窗口内是否曾出现 X/Z。
需要按 clock edge 验证已知值表达式。

constraints: required: signal, expected_state, time_range; optional: match_mode(default exact)
